data.one_liner: Real-time video and audio rooms for Flutter on Gravix Cloud.
data.what_it_does: Provides real-time video and audio room capabilities for Flutter applications connected to Gravix Cloud. It handles region-aware connections, token providers, join analytics, automatic data-saving, and video or voice effects.
use_when: You are building a live streaming, video call, or audio room app on Gravix Cloud.
You need region-aware connection optimization for low-latency media.
avoid_when: You are using a self-hosted WebRTC server or a different cloud provider like Agora or Twilio.
You only need local audio or video playback without a real-time room server backend.
strengths: Comprehensive suite of features including region probing, reconnect policies, and recovery.
Built-in Android beauty effects and voice effects.
Token management via local signing or endpoint providers.
weaknesses: Tied tightly to Gravix Cloud backend and infrastructure.
Platform support is currently limited to Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package, configuring tokens, and optionally adjusting Android Gradle properties/Proguard rules if excluding or configuring built-in beauty effects.
